phases.name: Build
phases.focus: Introduce tempo/threshold work, increase volume to 45-50 km/week, strength maintenance

phases.focus: Gradual volume descent, maintain some intensity, fresh for race day

phases.name: Recovery
phases.focus: Easy running, restore after goal race
